fixture_name: Express-collector corridor planning study — Canada TAC planning (Toronto context, PD-licensed portal)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Decision-load mechanism from simultaneous transfer-permission and signage changes on a 420,000 AADT corridor is a recognised collision-displacement/workload hazard with clear safety substance at this scale.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal 'collisions elsewhere along the route' claim is anchored by a verbatim EV-CA-003 quote matching the CRSAG audit objective, supplemented by recorded corridor input facts.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Safety concern kept categorically distinct from compliance questions; network-wide impact framing aligns with planning-stage CRSAG semantics without conflating frameworks.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Sequenced one-interchange-per-quarter rollout with before/after speed-differential monitoring is specific, actionable, and operationally viable.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs correctly identified as not applicable on a controlled-access mainline, with the exclusion explicitly acknowledged and road users scoped to vehicle occupants.
